paper.title_en: Universal Structure of Horizon Formation in Generic Binary Black Hole Mergers
paper.abstract_en: A new common apparent horizon forms during a binary black hole merger and gives rise to outer and inner branches of marginally outer trapped surfaces. We derive the local structure of these branches. This event occurs in the fully nonlinear regime, outside the standard regimes of post-Newtonian inspiral theory and perturbations of a stationary black hole, yet it admits a universal description. Without assuming symmetry, we show that the stability operator of the marginally outer trapped surface must lose invertibility at formation. Outermost stability then implies that the vanishing eigenvalue is the principal one, with a strictly positive eigenfunction. Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction yields square-root branch separation with a shared linear drift. The outer and inner common horizons lie on a smooth marginally outer trapped tube along which slice time has a local minimum at formation, and nearby later slices intersect it in outer and inner branches whose separation scales as $(t-t_*)^{1/2}$. Sufficiently smooth quasilocal scalar functionals with nonzero first variation along the principal zero mode inherit the square-root separation and a shared linear term. We test these predictions in three binary black hole simulations, including an eccentric, precessing, unequal-mass system. In all three, the worldtube geometry and quasilocal scalars follow the predicted scaling. With the next-order term included, free-exponent fits to the surface geometry and quasilocal functionals recover the square-root exponent, $1/2$, to within half a percent, and diagnostics agree on the formation time within $5\times10^{-5}M$. The correlation between horizon shear and gravitational-wave news raises the possibility that common horizon formation has a signature in a short segment of the merger waveform.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在完全非线性、无对称性假设下推导双黑洞并合时公共视界形成的普适局域结构（稳定性算子不可逆、Lyapunov-Schmidt 约化给出平方根分支分离），并在三个数值模拟（含偏心、进动、不等质量）中定量检验预测，属于广义相对论基础中视界与陷获面理论的有实质理论深度与数值验证的工作，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 一般双黑洞并合中视界形成的普适结构
decision.abstract_zh: 在双黑洞并合过程中会形成一个公共表观视界，并产生边缘外陷获面的外分支与内分支。我们推导了这些分支的局域结构。该事件发生在完全非线性区域，超出了后牛顿旋近理论和稳态黑洞微扰的标准适用范围，却仍容许一种普适描述。在不假设对称性的情况下，我们证明边缘外陷获面的稳定性算子在形成时刻必然失去可逆性。最外层稳定性进而意味着消失的本征值是主本征值，且其本征函数严格为正。Lyapunov-Schmidt 约化给出具有共同线性漂移的平方根型分支分离。外公共视界与内公共视界位于一个光滑的边缘外陷获管上，沿该管切片时间在形成时刻取局部极小值，而附近较晚的切片与该管相交于外分支与内分支，其间距按 $(t-t_*)^{-1/2}$ 标度。沿主零模具有非零一阶变分的足够光滑的准局域标量泛函，继承平方根型分离与共同的线性项。我们在三个双黑洞模拟中检验了这些预言，其中包括一个偏心、进动、不等质量的系统。在这三个模拟中，世界管几何与准局域标量均遵循所预言的标度行为。在纳入次阶项后，对曲面几何与准局域泛函的自由指数拟合将平方根指数 $1/2$ 恢复到半百分比以内，且各诊断量对形成时刻的估计一致到 $5\times10^{-5}M$ 以内。视界剪切与引力波 news 之间的相关性提出了这样一种可能性：公共视界的形成在并合波形的短片段中具有特征信号。
